description: Set the Base USDC address that receives your weekly referral payouts (null to clear). Optional to activate — get_referral_link works first; earnings accrue until an address is set. Crypto-only programme (USDC on Base). Affiliate setup only — not a purchase. Available on the full MCP server (/api/mcp). Not available on the read-only discover MCP (/api/mcp/discover).
name: set_payout_address
title: Set referral payout address
